description.describe_ch: 落實「以強化學生基本體能並建立基礎運動知識」之體育教學宗旨，授課內容如下：（一）游泳課程─同時段依學生游泳能力進行分級分組協同教學。（二）陸上運動課程─依教師專長項目教學，每專項單元授課兩週，循序轉換。
description.describe_eh: In order to implement the goal of physical education, enhance students' basic strength condition and help them build up the fundamental knowledge of exercise. (1) Swimming course - Divide into groups in grades in coordination with teaching in a section of ability of swimming in accordance with students at the same time. (2) Field course - Base on teacher's specialty project in teaching, every project unit gives lessons for two weeks, change in a proper order.

targets.describe_ch: 廣植基礎健康體適能，厚實游泳基本能力，養成規律運動習慣。
targets.describe_en: To promote basic physical health and fitness, to enhance students basic swimming skills, make it a habit to exercise regularly

運動技能測驗：

Regular Performance

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
一、期中 (20分)：依體適能系統給分，兩項在全校大一後10%，需完成「體適能諮商輔導」及「補救教學3次」，無故未參加者本項0分。
 
二、期末 (40分)：
     1. 游泳與水上救生能力 20分
     2. 足球測驗：10分
     3. 飛鏢對抗賽：10分
 
三、平時 (40分) (平時成績為下列項目之加總)
    1. 出席與課堂表現：依班級整體與個人表現給分
    2. 遲到 -0.5~2；事病假-2~10分每多一次多扣一分，滿6次平時成績0分。曠課扣1/3平時成績；不告而別平時成績0分。
       ***缺席請以學校系統請假，並依學校規定時程處理，未完成請假記為曠課
    3. 游泳課不下水：
      (1) 生理期每月一次，需完成當日課堂觀察報告。
      (2) 因身體因素不能下水需出示證明，可以課堂觀察報告替代，本學期限一次。
      (3) 其他原因、未繳交報告、或超過限制次數皆記入請假扣分。
    4. 「總缺席6次」、「曠課3次」、「不告而別」平時成績0分，不接受加分，本學期不通過。
 
四、運動參與加分 (最高+20)
   1. 規律運動紀錄 (參閱ilearn資料)。
   2. 其他賽事視狀況給分，證明文件放入規律運動紀錄檔案。
   ¤ 曠課、不告而別之扣分不得以加分項加回。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Midterm (20 points): Based on the physical fitness grading system, students who score in the bottom 10% of two categories among all freshmen must complete “physical fitness counseling” and “three remedial sessions.” Failure to attend without a valid reason will result in a score of zero for this section.
 
Final (40 points):
  1. Swimming and Water Lifesaving Skills: 20 points
  2. Soccer Test: 10 points
  3. Darts Games: 10 points
 
Regular Performance (40 points) (Total of the following items):
  1. Attendance and Classroom Performance: Points based on overall class and individual performance
  2. Late: -0.5 to -2 points;
    LEAVE OF ABSENCE for illness or personal reasons: -2 to -10 points, with one additional point deducted for each additional absence. Six absences result in a regular performance score of 0 points.
    SKIP (unexcused absences) deduct 1/3 of the regular performance score;
    LEAVING WITHOUT PERMISSION: 0 points for regular performance.
    *** Leave of Absences must be reported through the school system and handled according to school regulations. Failure to complete the leave process will be marked as an unexcused absence.
  3. Not Swim in Swimming Class:
    (1) One instance per month due to menstruation, with a required observation report for the day’s class.
    (2) If unable to enter the water due to health reasons, a medical certificate must be provided, and an observation report may substitute. This is allowed once per semester.
    (3) Failure to submit the observation report or exceeding the allowed number of excuses will be counted as an absence and will result in deducted points for a Leave.
  4. “Six total absences,” “three unexcused absences,” or “leaving without permission” will result in a regular performance score of 0 points, with no bonus points accepted.
 
Bonus for sports participation (maximum +20 points):
1. Regular exercise records (refer to ilearn materials).
2. Points may be awarded for other competitions, depending on the situation. Proof of participation should be included in the regular exercise records.
3. School tug-of-war competition: +5 points.
¤ Points deducted for unexcused absences or leaving without permission cannot be recovered with bonus points.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
本課程強烈要求「運動員精神」：公平競爭、遵守規定，誠實、尊重、負責、團隊合作、堅持。
1. 上課必須穿著運動服，運動鞋，服裝不合者禁止點名簽到，陸上課禁穿牛仔褲、西裝褲、工作褲/迷彩褲、拖鞋、皮鞋、靴類...等非運動用服裝。
2. 游泳課程未下水：生理期每月一次/身體狀況(附證明)每學期一次不計扣分，需完成上課觀察紀錄(書面報告)。生理期超過每月一次/身體狀況每學期超過一次或未附證明/未繳交課堂報告，視同請假。
3. 上課未依規定使用手機，經勸不聽者，視同缺席。
4. 出缺席：
 (1) 每週上課點名，超過10分鐘才到即計遲到，遲到30分鐘以上該週計缺席。
 (2) 缺席請以學校系統請假，並依學校規定時程處理。本課程事病假證明只需親自手寫原因並拍照上傳。喪假不扣分，需附證明，並在請假後另通知老師避免被列為事假。
 (3) 缺席且未完成請假計為曠課，每次扣平時總成績1/3。
 (4) 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，本學期平時成績0分計算。
5. 常上iLearn並隨時注意iLearn公告，上課資料也會放在ilearn，並注意學校email的通知信。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
This course strongly emphasizes “sportsmanship”: fair competition, adherence to rules, honesty, respect, responsibility, teamwork, and perseverance.

1. Proper sportswear and sports shoes are required. Attendance will not be recorded for inappropriate attire. For  land-based sport/exercise classes, jeans, dress pants, cargo pants, sandals, leather shoes, and boots are prohibited.

2. Swimming class: Excused from entering the water only with medical proof (once per semester) or menstruation (once per month). An observation report must be submitted. More than the allowed frequency, no proof, no report, or other reasons = absence.

3.  Using a mobile phone during class without permission, ignore warning, will be considered an absence.

4. Attendance:
(1) Weekly roll call or check attendance: arriving more than 10 minutes late counts as LATE; more than 30 minutes late counts as an absence for that week.
(2) Leave of Absences must be reported through the school system and handled according to school regulations. In this course, personal and sick leave only require a handwritten explanation and a photo upload. Bereavement leave does not result in point deductions, but proof is required. Please inform the teacher after submitting the bereavement leave to avoid it being marked as personal leave.
(3) Absences without a leave request will be considered SKIP (unexcused absences), and each instance will result in a deduction of 1/3 of the regular performance score.
(4) If a student signs in or answers roll call but leaves early without informing the Teacher, and this is confirmed during a second roll call, it will be considered an act of deception. As a result, the student’s regular performance score for the semester will be calculated as 0.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1. 對運動和學習展現熱忱，積極參與活動，有助輕鬆通過！ 
2. 本課程為全實體上課，未開放線上課程
3. 轉適應體育班：加退選期間持「醫院證明」至體育教學中心辦理。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. This course is primarily conducted in Chinese. Students who have difficulty with Chinese, please work hard and learn the language as quickly as possible.

2. Frequently check iLearn and stay updated with iLearn announcements. Course materials will also be available on iLearn. Additionally, keep an eye on notifications sent to your school email.

3. Show enthusiasm for sports and learning, and actively participate in activities to help you pass easily!

4. This course is entirely in-person and does not offer online classes.

5. For switching to the Adapted Physical Education class: bring a “hospital certificate” to the Physical Education Teaching Center for processing.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，平時成績0分計算。
2. 書面報告、作業若有抄襲情事，本課程不通過，並送校規處理。
3. 考試找他人代考者，本課程不通過，並送校規處理。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Please make sure to inform the teacher if you need to leave early. Leaving early without informing the teacher after signing in or roll call will be considered as deceptive behavior upon second roll call confirmation, resulting in a regular performance score of 0 points.
     
  2. Written reports and assignments found to be plagiarized will result in failing the course and will be handled according to school policy.
     
  3. Having someone else take an exam will result in failing the course and will be handled according to school policy.

  1. Swimming and Water Lifesaving Skills: 20 points
  2. Soccer Test: 10 points
  3. Darts Games: 10 points
 
Regular Performance (40 points) (Total of the following items):
  1. Attendance and Classroom Performance: Points based on overall class and individual performance
  2. Late: -0.5 to -2 points;
    LEAVE OF ABSENCE for illness or personal reasons: -2 to -10 points, with one additional point deducted for each additional absence. Six absences result in a regular performance score of 0 points.
    SKIP (unexcused absences) deduct 1/3 of the regular performance score;
    LEAVING WITHOUT PERMISSION: 0 points for regular performance.
    *** Leave of Absences must be reported through the school system and handled according to school regulations. Failure to complete the leave process will be marked as an unexcused absence.
  3. Not Swim in Swimming Class:
    (1) One instance per month due to menstruation, with a required observation report for the day’s class.
    (2) If unable to enter the water due to health reasons, a medical certificate must be provided, and an observation report may substitute. This is allowed once per semester.
    (3) Failure to submit the observation report or exceeding the allowed number of excuses will be counted as an absence and will result in deducted points for a Leave.
  4. “Six total absences,” “three unexcused absences,” or “leaving without permission” will result in a regular performance score of 0 points, with no bonus points accepted.
 
Bonus for sports participation (maximum +20 points):
1. Regular exercise records (refer to ilearn materials).
2. Points may be awarded for other competitions, depending on the situation. Proof of participation should be included in the regular exercise records.
3. School tug-of-war competition: +5 points.
¤ Points deducted for unexcused absences or leaving without permission cannot be recovered with bonus points.
policy.course_pol:
本課程強烈要求「運動員精神」：公平競爭、遵守規定，誠實、尊重、負責、團隊合作、堅持。
1. 上課必須穿著運動服，運動鞋，服裝不合者禁止點名簽到，陸上課禁穿牛仔褲、西裝褲、工作褲/迷彩褲、拖鞋、皮鞋、靴類...等非運動用服裝。
2. 游泳課程未下水：生理期每月一次/身體狀況(附證明)每學期一次不計扣分，需完成上課觀察紀錄(書面報告)。生理期超過每月一次/身體狀況每學期超過一次或未附證明/未繳交課堂報告，視同請假。
3. 上課未依規定使用手機，經勸不聽者，視同缺席。
4. 出缺席：
 (1) 每週上課點名，超過10分鐘才到即計遲到，遲到30分鐘以上該週計缺席。
 (2) 缺席請以學校系統請假，並依學校規定時程處理。本課程事病假證明只需親自手寫原因並拍照上傳。喪假不扣分，需附證明，並在請假後另通知老師避免被列為事假。
 (3) 缺席且未完成請假計為曠課，每次扣平時總成績1/3。
 (4) 簽到或點名後，未告知老師而早退者，經第二次點名確認後，視同欺騙行為，本學期平時成績0分計算。
5. 常上iLearn並隨時注意iLearn公告，上課資料也會放在ilearn，並注意學校email的通知信。
policy.course_pol_en:
This course strongly emphasizes “sportsmanship”: fair competition, adherence to rules, honesty, respect, responsibility, teamwork, and perseverance.

1. Proper sportswear and sports shoes are required. Attendance will not be recorded for inappropriate attire. For  land-based sport/exercise classes, jeans, dress pants, cargo pants, sandals, leather shoes, and boots are prohibited.

2. Swimming class: Excused from entering the water only with medical proof (once per semester) or menstruation (once per month). An observation report must be submitted. More than the allowed frequency, no proof, no report, or other reasons = absence.

3.  Using a mobile phone during class without permission, ignore warning, will be considered an absence.

4. Attendance:
(1) Weekly roll call or check attendance: arriving more than 10 minutes late counts as LATE; more than 30 minutes late counts as an absence for that week.
(2) Leave of Absences must be reported through the school system and handled according to school regulations. In this course, personal and sick leave only require a handwritten explanation and a photo upload. Bereavement leave does not result in point deductions, but proof is required. Please inform the teacher after submitting the bereavement leave to avoid it being marked as personal leave.
(3) Absences without a leave request will be considered SKIP (unexcused absences), and each instance will result in a deduction of 1/3 of the regular performance score.
(4) If a student signs in or answers roll call but leaves early without informing the Teacher, and this is confirmed during a second roll call, it will be considered an act of deception. As a result, the student’s regular performance score for the semester will be calculated as 0.
policy.course_rem:
1. 對運動和學習展現熱忱，積極參與活動，有助輕鬆通過！ 
2. 本課程為全實體上課，未開放線上課程
3. 轉適應體育班：加退選期間持「醫院證明」至體育教學中心辦理。
policy.course_rem_en:
1. This course is primarily conducted in Chinese. Students who have difficulty with Chinese, please work hard and learn the language as quickly as possible.

2. Frequently check iLearn and stay updated with iLearn announcements. Course materials will also be available on iLearn. Additionally, keep an eye on notifications sent to your school email.

3. Show enthusiasm for sports and learning, and actively participate in activities to help you pass easily!

4. This course is entirely in-person and does not offer online classes.

5. For switching to the Adapted Physical Education class: bring a “hospital certificate” to the Physical Education Teaching Center for processing.
